name: Shadowcast Obelisk
desc:
The Shadowcast Obelisk is an NPC located on the [Moon's Eyrie](location:moons_eyrie) atop a path leading to a high-up, dangerous and [windy](location:the_ethironal_shrine) area above its pillars and found in a crack in the wall at the end of the path. It must be located and interacted with, along with [4 other element-based obelisks](entity:saintsworn_obelisks), to obtain the Saintsworn Oath.

It can only be interacted with if you have at least 15 Shadowcast. When interacted with, Urek Felhand, the Hero of Shadow, will speak to the player.
